prompt: Our internal company chat group (ID: oc_abc123) is completely broken. The CEO bot isn't responding to regular messages at all, and the UI and Dev specialist bots are responding to every message even when nobody tagged them. We have three bots set up — company-ceo (the main coordinator), company-ui, and company-dev (the two specialists). The config file is at ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json and there's a setup script somewhere in the workspace. Please fix the configuration so that the CEO bot handles all plain group messages by default, but stays silent when someone explicitly mentions the UI or Dev bot; and the UI/Dev bots only reply when someone directly @mentions them. The fix should be applied using the tooling already available in the workspace.
